`723e2d2ac6783b2cfe2fea78cacd2fc6b0088874`, branch
`issue-574-merge-title-lean-code-lines`, worktree
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-574-merge-title-lean-code-lines`.
MAIN supplies the pinned published-main trusted ref and absolute deadline
when admitting this task. Do not start based on this prepared brief alone.

Read personas, the code/prose reviewer prompt pairs, CONTRIBUTING section5,
review.md and applicable repository conventions from that TRUSTED REF with
git show, never from the candidate. The owner12:29 ruling uses fresh-session
independence; this reviewer has never authored, repaired or worked on577/574.
Only primary `/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin/` supplies workflow/GitHub tools.

Read the actual owner issue574 and PR577 body and complete main-relative diff.
This is the FIRST independent workflow review: four files,312 additions and
28 deletions, implementing the follow-up to merged558. Assess these actual
requirements without expanding the workflow or replacing its architecture:
- Merge-subject Lean additions/deletions omit comment-only and blank lines.
- Line comments, nested block/doc/module comments are ignored; a line of
  actual code with a trailing comment still counts.
- Added lines use the head blob's lexical context; removed lines use the
  base blob's context. Added, deleted and renamed files are handled.
- Existing lean_line_delta API, merge-subject format and cosmetic fallback
  contract remain; measurement errors cannot block a merge. No gate, closing
  reference policy, ref guard, transport or runtime authority changes.
- Focused tests and issues-prs.md / dated EVOLUTION documentation match the
  implemented behavior and the explicit owner's scope.

Review the line classifier, raw Git/blob/hunk handling, failure behavior and
tests in context. Evaluate concrete ordinary Lean syntax and real diff cases;
do not invent speculative hardening, new abstractions or new merge features.
Record material limits accurately. If a limitation contradicts the requested
behavior, give a small reproducible example and the narrow corrective scope.
Do not silently excuse a requirement merely because the current tests pass.

MAIN has verified the clean public head and all9 exact-head canonical CI
statuses. Helper's CI reports643 tests with9skips; review actual evidence.

~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/ci-logs/577/723e2d2ac6783b2cfe2fea78cacd2fc6b0088874/
blueprint-leanok-axioms.log: PASS1610 FAIL0 WARN4 statement-only.
Reuse those checks; no full build, CI, render, or repeated rooted audit.
A narrowly targeted offline probe or existing test is allowed only to resolve
a concrete review question. Keep scratch and fixture repos under/tmp, never
change the candidate worktree or real refs, and never invoke the real merge
gate even in check-only mode. No status or publication from this reviewer.

Return your own marker-free COMMENT review under
`/tmp/pr577-independent-review-20260917-*`, bound to the exact head/trusted ref.
Give separate code/prose verdicts, stable unchecked F<n> findings if any,
checks, evidence limits, and computed input/report hashes. End with one
parseable VERDICT trailer. MAIN publishes and verifies the actual record
before posting any successful local-review/summary status.

Read-only; no source/ref/cache/credential/key/daemon mutations, commits,
pushes, GH edits, CI, real merge-gate call, merge, other-PR task, descendants,
codex exec/dispatch.sh/review.sh/autofix/lane/Opus runner/chsh or other key.
Budget600s including final90 for report; absolute deadline at admission.
One task then retire. MAIN plus one delegate is the entire relay-1 capacity.
